==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|præsentation||archaic}}

===Etymology===
From {{uder|en|fro|presentation}} (French {{m|fr|présentation}}), from {{uder|en|la|praesentātiōnem}}, accusative singular of {{m|la|praesentātiō||representation, exhibition}}. Morphologically {{suffix|en|present|ation}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{a|en|UK}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˌpɹɛzənˈteɪʃən/|a=RP}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˌpɹɛzənˈtɛjʃən/|a=SSB}}
*** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Back ache-presentation.wav|a=London}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˌpɾɛzənˈteʃən/|a=Scotland}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˌpɾɛzənˈteːʃən/|a=Wales,non-pane-pain}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌpɹɛzənˈteɪʃən/|/ˌpɹizənˈteɪʃən/|a=US,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-presentation.ogg|a=California}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌpɹezənˈtæɪʃən/|a=AU,NZ}}
* {{IPA|en|/pɹisɛnˈteɪʃən/|a=HK}}
* {{hyph|en|pre|sen|ta|tion}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=4}}

===Noun===
{{wp}}
{{en-noun|~}}

# The act of [[presenting]], or something [[presented]].
#: {{syn|en|presentment}}
#* {{RQ:Hooker Laws
|passage=Prayers are sometimes a '''presentation''' of mere desires.}}
# The [[outward]] [[appearance]] or [[representation]] of a person or thing to the human mind.
#: {{ux|en|Listen, James...with the ways that you speak, dress, and [[comport]] yourself, is it any wonder to you that your '''presentation''' to young ladies as a possible mate is , to say the least, lacking?}}
# A [[dramatic]] [[performance]].
# An [[award]] given to someone on a special [[occasion]].
# [[money|Money]] given as a [[wedding]] [[gift]].
# A [[lecture]] or [[speech]] given in front of an [[audience]].
# A slideshow created on a computer.
# {{lb|en|medicine}} The [[symptom]]s, [[sign]]s, and other possible indications of [[disease]], [[trauma]], etc., that are exhibited by a [[patient]] who has sought, or has otherwise come to, the attention of a [[physician]].
#: {{ux|en|The '''presentation''' of the thirty-four-year-old male in the emergency room was slight fever, dilated pupils, and marked disorientation.}}
# {{senseid|en|Q3409113}} {{lb|en|medicine}} The [[position]] of the [[foetus]] in the [[uterus]] at [[birth]].
# {{lb|en|mainly [[LGBT]]}} [[gender presentation|Gender presentation]]; [[gender expression]].
# {{lb|en|fencing}} Offering one's [[blade]] for [[engagement]] by the opponent.
# {{lb|en|mathematics}} The specification of a [[group]] by [[generator]]s and [[relator]]s.
# The act or [[right]] of offering a [[clergyman]] to the [[bishop]] or [[ordinary]] for [[institution]] in a [[benefice]].
#* {{RQ:Blackstone Commentaries
|passage=If the bishop admits the patron's '''presentation''', the clerk so admitted is next to be instituted by him.}}
# {{lb|en|immunology}} The preparation of [[antigen]] [[fragment]]s during the [[immune response]].
